text.en: - The Bayog National High School in Barangay Kahayagan, Municipality of Bayog, Province of Zamboanga del Sur is hereby converted into a national technical-vocational high school to be known as Bayog National Technical-Vocational High School.
- All personnel, assets, liabilities, and records of the Bayog National High School are hereby transferred to and absorbed by the Bayog National Technical-Vocational High School.

- The Secretary of Education shall immediately include in the Department's program the operationalization of the Bayog National Technical-Vocational High School, the funding of which shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
- The Secretary of Education shall formulate the rules and regulations implementing the provisions of this Act within ninety (90) days after its effectivity.
- This act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in any newspaper of general circulation.
